The mod file for the Interface in the Magical Valley theme.
I only posted the file in 2 places. that is [i][url=https://buymeacoffee.com/hreenna]buymeacoffee[/url][/i] and [i]nexusmods[/i].
You can donate to support me through BMAC as well.

[list]
[*]It is currently still a beta testing version. Since I don't have time yet, I still can't check it all myself. 
[*]If you find any bugs or irregularities caused by my code or images. You can tell me in the comments.
[*]In the future there will definitely be corrections or additions. But I'd like to take a break. Therefore, it is unlikely that significant changes will be added anytime soon.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Within the file, only large font characters are edited. For small and medium letters I suggest you try using the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url]﻿﻿" mod.
[*]For reference (No need to set according to me) I used both small and medium sized "Gaegu" fonts and set the font color
[/list][code]    "B": 44,
    "G": 56,
    "R": 104,
    "A": 255,
[/code]
[list]
[*]I've attached some  editimage files of other mods I'm using, including  "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿" "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url]﻿" and "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿" in the folder. 
[*]You can replace the original file in your mod folder.
[/list]
